tableSpecs.name: users
tableSpecs.description: Danh tính toàn cục của người dùng; không đồng nhất với external SSO subject.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
account_type text NOT NULL CHECK (account_type IN ('adult','student','service'))
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active','limited','suspended','deactivated'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tableSpecs.name: external_identities
tableSpecs.description: Ánh xạ tài khoản bên KingDragonHub/OIDC sang user UUID nội bộ; không lưu password/token.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES identity.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
provider text NOT NULL
provider_subject text NOT NULL
linked_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revoked_at timestamptz
UNIQUE (provider,provider_subject)
UNIQUE (user_id,provider,provider_subject)

tableSpecs.name: profiles
tableSpecs.description: Thông tin hiển thị với quyền riêng tư tách biệt danh tính đăng nhập.
fields: user_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES identity.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
display_name text NOT NULL CHECK (length(btrim(display_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80)
locale text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'vi-VN'
visibility text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'private' CHECK (visibility IN ('private','organization','public_approved'))
updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tableSpecs.name: guardian_links
tableSpecs.description: Quan hệ người giám hộ–học sinh; xác minh trước khi có quyền xem dữ liệu.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
guardian_user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES identity.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
student_user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES identity.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','verified','revoked'))
verified_by uuid REFERENCES identity.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
verified_at timestamptz
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
CHECK (guardian_user_id <> student_user_id)
UNIQUE (guardian_user_id,student_user_id)

tableSpecs.name: policy_acknowledgments
tableSpecs.description: Bản ghi phiên bản chính sách đã xác nhận; không thay thế quy trình đồng ý hợp pháp.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES identity.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
policy_code text NOT NULL
policy_version text NOT NULL
acknowledged_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
source text NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('web','guardian','organization','admin'))
UNIQUE (user_id,policy_code,policy_version)

tableSpecs.name: organizations
tableSpecs.description: Trường, CLB hoặc đơn vị vận hành; tách khỏi người dùng toàn cục.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
slug text NOT NULL UNIQUE
display_name text NOT NULL
kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('school','center','club','organizer','other'))
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active','suspended','archived'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tableSpecs.name: organization_memberships
tableSpecs.description: Thành viên trong tổ chức, có trạng thái riêng và FK toàn vẹn.
fields: organization_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tenancy.organizations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES identity.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'invited' CHECK (status IN ('invited','active','suspended','left'))
joined_at timestamptz
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
PRIMARY KEY (organization_id,user_id)

tableSpecs.name: roles
tableSpecs.description: Vai trò nghiệp vụ theo code; không dùng một role global trong users.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
code text NOT NULL UNIQUE
description text NOT NULL
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tableSpecs.name: permissions
tableSpecs.description: Quyền chi tiết áp dụng bởi service, không mặc định do UI quyết định.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
code text NOT NULL UNIQUE
resource_type text NOT NULL
description text NOT NULL

tableSpecs.name: role_permissions
tableSpecs.description: Quan hệ N–N giữa vai trò và quyền.
fields: role_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tenancy.roles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
permission_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tenancy.permissions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
PRIMARY KEY (role_id,permission_id)

tableSpecs.name: role_assignments
tableSpecs.description: Phân vai trò theo membership trong tổ chức, không tự cấp quyền qua SSO claim.
fields: organization_id uuid NOT NULL
user_id uuid NOT NULL
role_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tenancy.roles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
assigned_by uuid REFERENCES identity.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
assigned_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
PRIMARY KEY (organization_id,user_id,role_id)
FOREIGN KEY (organization_id,user_id) REFERENCES tenancy.organization_memberships(organization_id,user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

tableSpecs.name: assets
tableSpecs.description: Danh mục asset source; không đại diện vật phẩm đã sở hữu.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
owner_organization_id uuid REFERENCES tenancy.organizations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES identity.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
slug text NOT NULL UNIQUE
kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('model3d','texture','image','video','audio','other'))
rights_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unverified' CHECK (rights_status IN ('unverified','approved','restricted','revoked'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tableSpecs.name: asset_versions
tableSpecs.description: Version/hash bất biến của GLB/ảnh/video; asset đã approve không cập nhật trong chỗ.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
asset_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES assets.assets(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
version integer NOT NULL CHECK (version > 0)
sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK (sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')
storage_key text NOT NULL
mime_type text NOT NULL
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft','review','approved','revoked'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
UNIQUE (asset_id,version)

tableSpecs.name: games
tableSpecs.description: Game Registry; danh mục game độc lập room, kết quả, phần thưởng.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
slug text NOT NULL UNIQUE
title text NOT NULL
kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('board','card','puzzle','stem','coding','simulation','party'))
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft','review','published','archived'))
created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES identity.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

tableSpecs.name: game_versions
tableSpecs.description: Phiên bản luật và manifest được pin vào phòng/trận; published không sửa.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
game_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog.games(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
version text NOT NULL
engine_api_version text NOT NULL
state_schema_version integer NOT NULL CHECK (state_schema_version > 0)
rules_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK (rules_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')
asset_manifest_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK (asset_manifest_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')
manifest jsonb NOT NULL
published_at timestamptz
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
UNIQUE (game_id,version)

tableSpecs.name: game_rooms
tableSpecs.description: Phòng chờ trước trận; một room có thể có nhiều trận rematch.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
game_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog.game_versions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
organization_id uuid REFERENCES tenancy.organizations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES identity.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
visibility text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'private' CHECK (visibility IN ('private','organization','classroom','public'))
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'waiting' CHECK (status IN ('draft','waiting','ready','in_match','closed','canceled','expired'))
capacity integer NOT NULL CHECK (capacity BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
UNIQUE (id,game_version_id)

tableSpecs.name: room_memberships
tableSpecs.description: Thành viên và ghế của phòng; chỉ ghế active được unique.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
room_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gameplay.game_rooms(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES identity.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
seat integer CHECK (seat >= 0)
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'joined' CHECK (status IN ('joined','ready','left','kicked'))
joined_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
UNIQUE (room_id,user_id)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX room_live_seat_unique ON gameplay.room_memberships(room_id,seat) WHERE seat IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('joined','ready');

tableSpecs.name: matches
tableSpecs.description: Trận cụ thể pin game_version từ room; kết quả server xác minh.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
room_id uuid NOT NULL
game_version_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog.game_versions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'created' CHECK (status IN ('created','active','paused','pending_review','finalized','aborted'))
config jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
started_at timestamptz
finalized_at timestamptz
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
FOREIGN KEY (room_id,game_version_id) REFERENCES gameplay.game_rooms(id,game_version_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
indexes: CREATE INDEX matches_by_room_idx ON gameplay.matches(room_id,created_at DESC);

tableSpecs.name: match_participants
tableSpecs.description: Người chơi/quan sát có định danh; ghế unique khi khác null.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
match_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gameplay.matches(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES identity.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
seat integer CHECK (seat >= 0)
role text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'player' CHECK (role IN ('player','host','observer'))
joined_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
CHECK (role = 'observer' OR seat IS NOT NULL)
UNIQUE (match_id,user_id)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX match_live_seat_unique ON gameplay.match_participants(match_id,seat) WHERE seat IS NOT NULL;

tableSpecs.name: match_commands
tableSpecs.description: Lệnh đã được Game Server kiểm tra; append-only, idempotent.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
match_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gameplay.matches(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
actor_user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES identity.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
seq bigint NOT NULL CHECK (seq > 0)
idempotency_key text NOT NULL
command_type text NOT NULL
payload jsonb NOT NULL
accepted_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
UNIQUE (match_id,seq)
UNIQUE (match_id,actor_user_id,idempotency_key)
FOREIGN KEY (match_id,actor_user_id) REFERENCES gameplay.match_participants(match_id,user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
indexes: CREATE INDEX match_commands_recent_idx ON gameplay.match_commands(match_id,seq DESC);

tableSpecs.name: match_snapshots
tableSpecs.description: Snapshot phiên bản state và hash để replay sau khi reconnect.
fields: match_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES gameplay.matches(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
state_revision bigint NOT NULL CHECK (state_revision >= 0)
schema_version integer NOT NULL CHECK (schema_version > 0)
state_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK (state_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')
state jsonb NOT NULL
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
PRIMARY KEY (match_id,state_revision)

tableSpecs.name: match_results
tableSpecs.description: Kết quả một lần cho một trận; sửa sai bằng dòng bù/version tương lai.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
match_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES gameplay.matches(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK (rules_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')
result_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK (result_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')
result jsonb NOT NULL
finalized_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
UNIQUE (id,match_id)

tableSpecs.name: match_result_entries
tableSpecs.description: Điểm/địa vị trong kết quả, không phải bảng xếp hạng hay ví Coin.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
result_id uuid NOT NULL
match_id uuid NOT NULL
user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES identity.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
placement integer CHECK (placement > 0)
score_numeric numeric(18,5)
winner boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
FOREIGN KEY (result_id,match_id) REFERENCES gameplay.match_results(id,match_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (match_id,user_id) REFERENCES gameplay.match_participants(match_id,user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
UNIQUE (result_id,user_id)

tableSpecs.name: content_items
tableSpecs.description: Trang/bài/khối nội dung; không trộn event/season/campaign.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
owner_organization_id uuid REFERENCES tenancy.organizations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES identity.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
slug text NOT NULL
content_type text NOT NULL
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX content_global_slug_unique ON publishing.content_items(slug) WHERE owner_organization_id IS NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX content_org_slug_unique ON publishing.content_items(owner_organization_id,slug) WHERE owner_organization_id IS NOT NULL;

tableSpecs.name: content_revisions
tableSpecs.description: Nội dung theo revision, hash và người tạo, không ghi đè bản cũ.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
content_item_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES publishing.content_items(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
revision integer NOT NULL CHECK (revision > 0)
locale text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'vi-VN'
schema_version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (schema_version > 0)
body jsonb NOT NULL
body_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK (body_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')
created_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES identity.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
UNIQUE (content_item_id,locale,revision)

tableSpecs.name: content_publications
tableSpecs.description: Con trỏ phát hành và cửa sổ thời gian; phải được phê duyệt đúng revision.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
revision_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES publishing.content_revisions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
approved_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES identity.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
channel text NOT NULL
target_policy jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
priority integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
starts_at timestamptz NOT NULL
ends_at timestamptz
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled' CHECK (status IN ('scheduled','active','expired','revoked'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
CHECK (ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at > starts_at)

tableSpecs.name: domain_outbox
tableSpecs.description: Thông điệp nghiệp vụ sau commit; consumer retry idempotent.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
aggregate_type text NOT NULL
aggregate_id uuid NOT NULL
event_type text NOT NULL
schema_version integer NOT NULL CHECK (schema_version > 0)
dedupe_key text UNIQUE
payload jsonb NOT NULL
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
published_at timestamptz
indexes: CREATE INDEX outbox_pending_idx ON integration.domain_outbox(created_at) WHERE published_at IS NULL;

tableSpecs.name: audit_events
tableSpecs.description: Lịch sử tác động append-only và redacted; không đưa token hoặc dữ liệu trẻ em vào payload.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
actor_type text NOT NULL CHECK (actor_type IN ('human','agent','service'))
actor_user_id uuid REFERENCES identity.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
organization_id uuid REFERENCES tenancy.organizations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
action_code text NOT NULL
resource_type text NOT NULL
resource_id uuid
correlation_id uuid NOT NULL
redacted_metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
indexes: CREATE INDEX audit_time_idx ON integration.audit_events(occurred_at DESC);

tableSpecs.name: agent_approvals
tableSpecs.description: Human approval gắn với hash và phạm vi chính xác, có hạn dùng.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
requested_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES identity.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
approved_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES identity.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
organization_id uuid REFERENCES tenancy.organizations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
tool_code text NOT NULL
target_resource text NOT NULL
revision_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK (revision_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')
scope_hash text NOT NULL CHECK (scope_hash ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'approved' CHECK (status IN ('approved','consumed','revoked','expired'))
expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL
consumed_at timestamptz
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
CHECK (approved_by <> requested_by)
CHECK ((status = 'consumed') = (consumed_at IS NOT NULL))

tableSpecs.name: agent_invocations
tableSpecs.description: Một lần gọi typed tool và kết quả auditable; không cấp tool qua table này.
fields: id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
initiated_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES identity.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
approval_id uuid REFERENCES integration.agent_approvals(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
organization_id uuid REFERENCES tenancy.organizations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
tool_code text NOT NULL
idempotency_key text NOT NULL
status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued' CHECK (status IN ('queued','running','succeeded','failed','canceled'))
started_at timestamptz
finished_at timestamptz
redacted_result jsonb
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
UNIQUE (initiated_by,tool_code,idempotency_key)

defaultRls: ENABLE + FORCE RLS without policies; deny all non-bypass roles; no production writes
targetEnv: isolated development or CI test PostgreSQL only
